subject: What is preferred way to specify graphics size?

messages.author: 9ec69ca07f36d6a1
messages.subject: What is preferred way to specify graphics size?
parts:
I frequently produce graphics whose size I control using for example
pdf(..., width=4, height=3) (sizes are in inches). I see from knitr
documentation how to tell LaTeX what size to use for \includegraphics,
but how do we pass through other arguments to the graphics device
(e.g;., pdf()) that knitr automatically calls?
Thanks
Frank Harrell

messages.author: 30b406a9189eeb25
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] What is preferred way to specify graphics size?
parts:
You can set the R device options globally (in \SweaveOpts) or for any chunk.  e.g. for your example:

\begin{figure}
<<fig=TRUE, dev=pdf, fig.width=4, fig.heigth=3>>=
plot(...)
@
\end{figure}

\begin and \end{figure} if you specify for example <<chunkname,

doesn't allow caption=". . ." or {. . .} or "<. . .>". Unless someone
has a better idea I'll intercept ;; inside caption= and change it to a
comma, inside the hook.

Frank

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Re: What is preferred way to specify graphics size?
parts:
The built-in graphical devices only support three key arguments: width
(fig.width), height (fig.height) and dpi (dpi). I thought these three
were enough... If you want other arguments, you have to write a new
device function, e.g.

my_pdf = function(file, width, height) {
pdf(file, width = width, height = height, pointsize =
opts_current$get('pointsize'))
}

The object opts_current gives you the chunk options for the current
chunk, so you can use any custom options in your hooks or device
functions, e.g.

<<pdf-with-pointsize, dev=my_pdf, width=5, height=4, pointsize=10>>=
plot(1)
@

For the caption problem, I have been thinking on how to deal with
commas as well. You can use other characters to replace commas when
writing the captions, and replace them back to commas in the hook to
get the real captions. For example, use ;; as , and I guess a neater
solution is to be able to escape the comma like \,. I will see what I
can do.

Regards,
Yihui
--

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Re: What is preferred way to specify graphics size?
parts:
You can override the default device by setting a global option like
\SweaveOpts{dev=your_dev_name}.

In fact you may not need to evaluate 'name' in @name; there is an
alternative way to do that. You can set

opts_knit$set(eval.opts = c('eval', 'echo', 'caption')) # see
http://yihui.name/knitr/options#package_options

then use

<<>>=
.fig.caption = 'a long long caption here'
<<my-caption, caption=.fig.caption>>=
@

In this case, the caption will be evaluated to the real character string.

Regards,
Yihui
--

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Re: What is preferred way to specify graphics size?
parts:
Sorry this is a bug in the object opts_current. It should have been
created _after_ the options have been evaluated. I have fixed it in
the development version: https://github.com/yihui/knitr Now you should
be able to use opts_current$get('caption') to get the real caption
string.

Or alternatively, you can use the argument 'options' in the hook
function; it is always the evaluated version.

knit_hooks$set(caption = function(before, options, envir) {
if (!before) paste('\\caption{', options$caption, '}')
})

Theoretically 'options' in the hook function should be identical to
opts_current$get(), but due to that bug, they are not. The fix will
appear in v0.3 on CRAN about two weeks later.

Regards,
Yihui

messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Re: What is preferred way to specify graphics size?
parts:
devtools depends on RCurl which depends on libcurl; I will suggest
Hadley consider dropping this dependency because all devtools needs
from RCurl is to be able to download files from the https protocol.

An alternative way to install the beta version is to download the tar
ball and run R CMD INSTALL:
https://github.com/yihui/knitr/tarball/master Perhaps this is not
clear enough in https://github.com/yihui/knitr#readme

'A B' is not a legal R expression, so parse() cannot parse it; I'm not
sure if this should be considered as a bug, because 'eval.opts' means
the option will be evaluated like an R expression. What do you expect
knitr to behave in this case?

Regards,
Yihui

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Re: What is preferred way to specify graphics size?
parts:
Literal commas can be written as \, now in the devel version.

It is entirely possible to implement your idea (use commas in quoted
strings), but I'd like to keep the syntax consistent -- whenever a
comma has its literal meaning, it must be escaped. Otherwise we have
to remember when to escape it and when not to.

I hope this is an acceptable solution.

Regards,
Yihui
